formulas.name: Cauchy–Riemann Equations
formulas.symbols: f=u+iv, the real and imaginary parts of a complex function.
formulas.conditions: Necessary for differentiability; sufficient together with continuous partials.
formulas.whenToUse: Checking whether a given f is analytic.
formulas.commonMistake: Checking only one of the two equations.

formulas.name: Cauchy's Integral Formula
formulas.symbols: C: simple closed contour; z0: point inside C.
formulas.conditions: f analytic on and inside C.
formulas.whenToUse: Evaluating a contour integral with a simple pole inside the contour.
formulas.commonMistake: Applying it when z0 is outside C (answer should be 0 there via Cauchy's Theorem instead).

formulas.name: Generalized Cauchy Integral Formula
formulas.symbols: n: the order of the derivative sought.
formulas.conditions: f analytic on and inside C, z0 inside C.
formulas.whenToUse: Evaluating integrals with a higher-order pole.
